remarks: MULTIPLE OFFERS! HIGHEST AND BEST DUE 6/26 by 5pm. We are doing this one a little different. Showings started 6/19. 20 showings and 5 offers so far and we expect more. 3 offers are over ask and 2 are cash. Best of luck. 2400 sq ft for under 500k?? This is not a rehab. Charming colonial home with 3 bedrooms plus a den, along with 2 full baths. Located on a tree-lined street in the heart of Glenbrook, it offers a walk-up finished attic and is conveniently close to an elementary school and the Glenbrook train station. Features include an oversized 2-car detached garage. Ideal for first-time homebuyers or investors, this property is a must-see.
